events.headline: From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 ramps to northbound and southbound I-405 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

Westbound Interstate 90 is open to two lanes at milepost 174, at Hansen Road just west of Moses Lake, while eastbound I-90 is open to one lane from Aug. 24 until January of 2027. Eastbound travelers heading north or south of Hansen Road must use Exit 169 at Hiawatha Road. Westbound travelers heading north may use exit 174. Travelers heading south must use exit 169 and follow the South Frontage Road detour.
From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from East Mercer Way will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.
The westbound Winchester rest area on I90 at milepost 161.83 will be closed for maintenance until further notice.

From 7 p.m. to 5 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings from Sunday, Oct. 18, to Monday morning, Nov. 9, crews will close the Snoqualmie Parkway on-ramp to westbound I-90 and the eastbound I-90 off-ramp to westbound SR 18.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from Bellevue Way Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.
